# TODO-33 turn 5: locked validation judgement and proposed records

Status: the 75 frozen regimes all pass. No new measurement, seed, selection, iteration, regime, target or threshold was introduced. Records below are proposed only. The original raw AB-12 results remain unchanged.

## Inputs, qualification and uncertainty

Stage 1: open window, bare-crystal all-faces bound; four edge cases (lab, handheld edge, 1 m, 5 m); both cyclic settings; times 10/60 s; source labels 25/50/100/250/500/1000 counts plus 1 MBq default; fields 0/.05/.10/.20 microSv/h. E0/E4 cover 448 cells, E5/E6 cover the declared 100/250/1000/default known-scale subset. E4 uses D-46 pixel-area MLEM at the frozen 400 iterations. No pair-resolution claim.

Validation seeds BG_VALIDATION32: 730001, 860364, 990727, 1121090, 1251453, 1381816, 1512179, 1642542, 1772905, 1903268, 2033631, 2163994, 2294357, 2424720, 2555083, 2685446, 2815809, 2946172, 3076535, 3206898, 3337261, 3467624, 3597987, 3728350, 3858713, 3989076, 4119439, 4249802, 4380165, 4510528, 4640891, 4771254.
Each estimator/cell has N=32 independent outer seed clusters x 100 acquisitions=3200. Seeds are disjoint from development, selection and reserved confirmation; no confirmation run was made. Sensitivities use the same 32 seeds with separate pinned purpose streams; their transported baseline is paired with their own variants, not acquisition-paired with the main validation responses.

All +/- values in the descriptive tables are outer-seed SE, not confidence bounds or accuracy guarantees. Signed-vector SE is componentwise SD(seed means)/sqrt(32). Rate SE uses the 32 seed rates and is shown in percentage points. RMS SE is the descriptive delta approximation SE(mean squared error)/(2*RMS), derived from the retained squared-error seed distribution. Rare alias errors can make this approximation unstable; the exact retained quantity is RmsSquaredSeedSE in the JSON. Norms have no asserted scalar SE; paired vector component SE is supplied. Finite calibration is shared inside each seed, not 100 independent calibrations.

## Frozen BD-3 audit: 75 pass, 0 fail, 0 unqualified

The existing aggregator already implements the verdict step; no code change was needed. A separate scratch audit verified source sidecars and every raw output hash, exact seed lists/repeats/iterations, and recomputed the 10,000 whole-seed centred bootstrap with seed 131071 from raw signed-vector moments. The resulting shared normalized radius is exactly 0.20118893772496366, identical to the planner aggregate. All 75 count screens, paired norms, targets and upper bounds were verified against the existing verdicts.

Each association and jointly trusted-association screen requires >=3061/3200 (conditional one-sided CP lower95 >=.95). At 3061 the lower bound is .9501612431519745; at 3060 it is .9498287113184153. Minimum observed counts among the 75 are 3133 associated and 3121 jointly trusted. The vector UCL is ||mean paired signed excess|| + 0.20118893772496366 * pinned target. Target=sqrt(2)*grid step: lab .5499719409228704, head .5812203466571243, 1 m 3.7498086881104795, 5 m 18.7490434405524 mm. This is an engineering cell-equivalence convention against each estimator's own ideal response; bootstrap coverage is approximate. It is not an absolute-error, acquisition-level or RMS guarantee.

Tightest normalized result: lab, non-cyclic, 60 s, S=500, F=.10: vector norm .3038881610178475 mm; UCL .41453643159065623 mm < .5499719409228704 mm. Vector SE=(.04888658950661242,.006026268451177402) mm. Screens 3188 associated and 3186 jointly trusted. No failing regime exists to list. The 373 cells outside the frozen regimes are not promoted after looking at validation, including the 112 ideal cells; cyclic 1 m has no pinned regime.

## Per-case recovery, benchmarks and ideal cost

At S=1000, 60 s, F=.10, cyclic E0 -> E4 RMS (mm): lab 8.532 -> .401; head 9.571 -> .663; 1 m 39.500 -> 13.623; 5 m 44.832 -> 30.126. Non-cyclic: lab 8.532 -> .502; head 11.210 -> .713; 1 m 8.185 -> 9.041; 5 m 38.110 -> 40.382. The correction is a mean-pull recovery in its pinned regimes, not a universal RMS improvement. Cyclic 1 m improves strongly at high counts but has no pinned pass; non-cyclic far heads retain a different intrinsic ideal response.

At S=250, 60 s, F=.20, non-cyclic E4 association is lab 2025/3200, head 1252/3200, 1 m 1571/3200, 5 m 1823/3200; RMS is 6.643, 9.425, 52.202, 239.338 mm. Counting noise/aliases remain. The fixed 1 MBq default is not a high-count condition at field distance: expected counts at 60 s are lab 4626.2824, head 10400.1753, 1 m 242.31075, 5 m 9.4436172. These are mean transported source counts, not exact draws. At the far default, E4 may worsen RMS despite reducing a mean pull. All underlying signed vectors, uncertainties and counts are retained below and in the published JSON.

E5/E6 are explicit calibrated known-scale benchmarks, not universal upper/lower performance bounds. At S=1000, 60 s, F=.10, non-cyclic E4/E5/E6 RMS is lab .502/1.173/.647; head .713/.719/2.444; 1 m 9.041/8.990/7.097; 5 m 40.382/39.814/33.241 mm. More iterations, joint fitting and finite-mask source artefacts can exchange bias for variance.

### Ideal environment: whole source/time grid

Each row is the actual no-field cell, not inferred from a corrected-field result. E4 adds a nuisance component even in the ideal case, so it can cost resolution and association. At S=1000, 60 s, E0 -> E4 ideal RMS (cyclic / non-cyclic) is lab .647 -> .416 / .647 -> 1.287; head .972 -> .503 / .968 -> .606; 1 m 22.211 -> 6.367 / 6.277 -> 7.554; 5 m 26.017 -> 14.238 / 34.296 -> 38.641 mm. A zero measured seed SE (cyclic 5 m E0 here) reflects an identical grid-quantized response in this ensemble; it is not zero physical uncertainty.

Cost SE is derived with the paired seed influence difference (MSE4_i-meanMSE4)/(2*RMS4) - (MSE0_i-meanMSE0)/(2*RMS0), then its SD/sqrt(32); descriptive delta approximation only.

### Fitted amplitude and unchanged gate

The legacy AB-11 threshold/Z is unchanged, computed from the same raw image and declared calibration. Trust counts are identical beside E0/E4/E5/E6 in the main study, while association with each reported answer differs. A trusted gate does not certify the E4 answer or its absolute precision. Lab, S=1000, 60 s, F=.20: raw E0 is trusted 3200/3200 while associated 0/3200; E4 is associated 3200/3200 cyclic and 3197/3200 non-cyclic. Within the pinned set the largest E4 trusted-but-misassociated count is 66 (5 m cyclic, 10 s, S=500, F=.10): trust 3187, jointly trusted association 3121. Across all field cells it is 310 (1 m cyclic, 10 s, S=250, F=.05): trust 2139, joint association 1829. These are source-present location errors, not null false-alarm calibration.

Beta is a fitted nuisance count, not ambient dose. It can differ materially from the independent source-free rate cross-check: e.g. lab non-cyclic S=1000/F=.10 gives 746.31 +/- 1.79 vs 976.77 +/- .20 counts. The fit distributes observed counts between its source grid and nuisance component; a good localisation does not validate a physical scale estimate.

## BD-7 sensitivities: descriptive only

All 24 bases are time 60 s, F=.20, source S=250/1000/default, both cyclic settings and four cases. Every variant has N=3200 across 32 clusters. Shape is independent transported bare background, finite measured bare acquisitions of 600/3600 s, or front-only shape on bare truth. Fixed-scale modes also have signed offsets +/-10/25/50%. No sensitivity condition is assigned a new tolerance, a pass verdict or a permissible scale interval.

For E4 across the 24 bases, 600 s measured-shape RMS / transported RMS ranges .784013 to 1.151019; 3600 s ranges .997130 to 1.047792. These observed ratios are not a calibration-duration guarantee. The 600 s largest increase is cyclic 1 m S=1000 (16.466 -> 18.953 mm); the 3600 s largest increase is non-cyclic 1 m S=1000 (10.109 -> 10.592 mm). A longer acquisition reduces calibration counting uncertainty but leaves model mismatch and observation noise.

### Signed scale offsets: S=1000 slice, full +/-10/25/50% grid

The full S=250/default responses and E5/E6 shape variants are in the committed sensitivity JSON. Even +/-10% has asymmetric, case-dependent effects: handheld non-cyclic E6 at -10% gives RMS 8.941 mm, association 1341/3200, vs transported E6; +10% gives 1.153 mm, 3185/3200. A -50% offset at lab non-cyclic gives E6 RMS 8.650 mm and 1153/3200 association. No universal allowable scale error is supported, and this task does not create a dose-counter scale transfer.

## Commit-ready evidence and reproduction

The two original aggregate envelopes and all 64 raw run records were validated before publication. Existing provenance.publish wrote the same aggregate bytes and corresponding sidecars to new result filenames; destination sidecars and byte equality were rechecked. No existing result was replaced; no product code or aggregator changed in this turn.
